item.text:
Implemented Task 002 and committed it as `9d25d579cc02be91f43be5eb3b7a4ea0113c60e4`.

Project pages now support creating tasks, toggling completion, and filtering by All, Open, or Completed. Tasks are stored by project in SQLite and retain creation order.

Verified with `node --check server.js`, `git diff --check`, and a live API check covering health, project and task creation, completion persistence, blank-title validation, and project-page controls. The working tree is clean.

Run with `npm start`; set `PORT` and `DB_PATH` as needed.
